assessment: The most useful distinctions concern debt denomination and institutional choke points. Ethereum censorship concerns had observable inclusion-delay consequences, but not complete exclusion; privacy and legal claims need narrower definitions. The inflation peak is retrospective confirmation of revised timing. DBS and HDFC five-year theses are unfinished, while the DBS retail-crypto statement was already inconsistent with issuer guidance. Bitcoin's first three-year direction and Russian oil diversion worked.
verification_limitations: Captured website text is not an authenticated publication-date version.
Chart-only numerical claims have not been visually verified.
Selected stock/ETF adjusted-close comparisons are disclosed where used; no reconstructed portfolio backtest has been performed.
Unresolved verdicts are not forecast failures or successes; no aggregate hit rate is inferred.
